grading_boundary.string_proxy: Can detect transport and phrase regressions only; cannot return behavioral PASS for clarification cases.
grading_boundary.semantic_review: Must review actual question, user answer, transcript ordering, and observed file changes when telemetry supports those facts.
grading_boundary.unavailable: Absent transcript, answer, native activation, or dependent-edit telemetry is evidence unavailable, never PASS and never a behavioral FAIL.
grading_boundary.native_vs_forced: Native activation observations and explicitly forced skill-load runs are separate evidence classes; forced loading cannot be reported as native activation.
